subject: Post-demo: commercial onramp & security gating — procurement options
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@goodhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: commercial onramp & security gating — procurement options

Thanks again for the demo earlier today, Alice — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you to a fast pilot without surprises.

Key notes from call:
- GoodHealth interested in Redwood for patient-facing summarization and triage (initial pilot: 2-4 models, ~500k tokens/month).
- Procurement preference: typically PO for contracts >$10k/mo; however team is open to marketplace if that speeds onboarding.
- Security asks: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA signed, and a short security questionnaire from your InfoSec team.

Asks / proposed path:
1) Which procurement route would you prefer if both are an option: Marketplace enrollment (fast) OR PO/invoice (standard)?
2) Can procurement share a target procurement date / cutover window? You mentioned end-of-month would be ideal.
3) Security: we can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II and a pre-filled security questionnaire; Marissa will lead contract/DPA redlines.

Attachments: Redwood-OnePager.pdf (product summary), SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf (redacted).

If it helps, I suggest a 20-min alignment between your procurement + security, and our legal (Marissa) + billing (Karthik) to confirm process. Proposed slots tomorrow 10–11am PT or Friday 9–10am PT.

Thanks — I can set up the invite once you confirm who should be on the procurement and security side.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0184

Subject: Re: Post-demo: commercial onramp & security gating — procurement options

Vivek — thanks for the recap and for the docs. Quick answers from our side: we like the Marketplace route for speed, but our purchasing policy still requires a PO for anything that will be on contract beyond three months or above $8k/month. If you can provide an interim Marketplace path while we finalize a PO, that would be ideal.

Security: our InfoSec lead (D. Kelly) will need the SOC2 report and the questionnaire answered. I'll loop Tim Ward (integration lead) and Procurement so they can sync scheduling. Target timeline: aiming to have procurement sign-off by 30 Apr if we keep the process tight.

I've attached a short procurement intake form and a stub SOW from our side — these are internal but should help with scoping.

On the meeting slots, Friday 9am PT works for us.

Cheers,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Partnerships | GoodHealth Inc
alice@goodhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3241

- Brief intros (2 min)
- Procurement route options & timing (Marketplace vs PO) (8 min)
- Security checklist: SOC2, DPA redline timeline, targeted questionnaire responses (7 min)

- Redwood: provide SOC2 Type II (attached) and pre-filled security questionnaire by EOD today (owner: Marissa).
- GoodHealth: confirm procurement preferred route and internal PO timeline (owner: procurement@goodhealth.com).
- Redwood Billing: provide invoice/PO flow and marketplace enrollment steps (owner: Karthik).
- Legal/Contract: Marissa will review any DPA redlines and push back within 72 hours of receiving comments.

I've attached the SOC2 again and a short one-page next-steps checklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Procurement-Materials
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6789012 (deal RDW-3458).

If procurement confirms marketplace as the preferred interim route, we can activate sandbox access immediately while finalizing the PO paperwork. Otherwise, we can accelerate an invoice/PO path — Karthik will outline required billing fields to match your AP system.

I'll schedule the meeting and include an optional DocuSign for the DPA if you want a faster electronic signature path: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/RDW-3458

Thanks — invite to follow.
